[SERVICE]
    Flush 1
    Log_Level info
[INPUT]
    Name tail
    Path /var/log/containers/*.log
    Parser docker
    Tag kube.*
    Refresh_Interval 5
[OUTPUT]
    Name loki
    Match *
    Host {{loki_host}}
    Port 3100
    Labels job=fluentbit
